# p09_imo1964

```lean
import Mathlib

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- Proof sketch:
  -- 1. Use `Nat.modEq` to rewrite the divisibility condition as a congruence
  --    `2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]`.
  -- 2. Write `n = 3 * q + r` with `0 ≤ r < 3`.  Then
  --    `2 ^ n ≡ (2 ^ 3) ^ q * 2 ^ r ≡ 1 ^ q * 2 ^ r ≡ 2 ^ r [MOD 7]`.
  -- 3. Compute the three possible residues:
  --       `2 ^ 0 ≡ 1`, `2 ^ 1 ≡ 2`, `2 ^ 2 ≡ 4` (mod 7).
  --    Hence `2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]` iff `r = 0`, i.e. `3 ∣ n`.
  constructor
  · intro h
    -- turn the divisibility into a congruence
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.of_dvd h)
    -- write `n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3`
    set q := n / 3
    set r := n % 3
    have hqr : n = 3 * q + r := by
      exact (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
    -- use the congruence for the decomposition of the exponent
    have hpow : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [hqr]
    have hpow' : (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * q) * 2 ^ r) [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [pow_add] using (Nat.ModEq.rfl : (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) [MOD 7])
    have hpow'' : (2 ^ (3 * q) * 2 ^ r) ≡ ((2 ^ 3) ^ q * 2 ^ r) [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [pow_mul] using (Nat.ModEq.rfl :
        (2 ^ (3 * q) * 2 ^ r) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * q) * 2 ^ r) [MOD 7])
    have hpow''' : ((2 ^ 3) ^ q * 2 ^ r) ≡ (1 ^ q * 2 ^ r) [MOD 7] := by
      have : (2 ^ 3) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
        norm_num
      exact this.pow_left q
    have hpow'''' : (1 ^ q * 2 ^ r) ≡ 2 ^ r [MOD 7] := by
      simpa using (Nat.ModEq.one_mul (2 ^ r) (n := 7))
    have hfinal : (2 ^ n) ≡ 2 ^ r [MOD 7] := by
      exact hmod.trans (hpow.trans (hpow'.trans (hpow''.trans (hpow'''.trans hpow''''))))
    -- now analyse the possible values of `r`
    have hrlt : r < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    rcases Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hrlt (by decide : 2 ≤ 3) with hcases
    have : r = 0 ∨ r = 1 ∨ r = 2 := by
      interval_cases r <;> tauto
    rcases this with h0 | h1 | h2
    · -- r = 0, so 3 ∣ n
      left
      have : n = 3 * q := by
        simpa [h0, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero] using hqr
      exact ⟨q, this.symm⟩
    · -- r = 1 leads to contradiction
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 := by
        simpa [h1, pow_one] using congrArg (fun x => x % 7) hfinal
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
      linarith
    · -- r = 2 leads to contradiction
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 := by
        simpa [h2, pow_two] using congrArg (fun x => x % 7) hfinal
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
      linarith
  · intro hdiv
    rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
    -- rewrite `n` as `3 * k`
    have hpow : (2 ^ n) = (2 ^ 3) ^ k := by
      simpa [hk, pow_mul] using rfl
    have : (2 ^ n) - 1 = ((2 ^ 3) ^ k) - 1 := by
      simpa [hpow]
    have hmod : (2 ^ 3) ^ k - 1 = 7 * ((2 ^ 3) ^ k - 1) / 7 := by
      have : (2 ^ 3) = 8 := by norm_num
      have : (8 : ℕ) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by norm_num
      have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ k) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := this.pow k
      have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ k) - 1 ≡ 0 [MOD 7] := this.sub Nat.ModEq.rfl
      exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff_modEq).mp this
    exact ⟨((2 ^ 3) ^ k - 1) / 7, by
      simpa [hpow] using hmod⟩

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  -- Proof sketch:
  -- 1. As in part (a), the residues of `2 ^ n` modulo 7 are `1,2,4` repeating every three.
  -- 2. Adding `1` gives possible residues `2,3,5`, none of which is `0`.
  -- 3. Hence `7` never divides `2 ^ n + 1`.
  intro h
  have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] ∨ (2 ^ n) ≡ 2 [MOD 7] ∨ (2 ^ n) ≡ 4 [MOD 7] := by
    -- analyse `n mod 3`
    have hrem : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      interval_cases (n % 3) <;> tauto
    rcases hrem with h0 | h1 | h2
    · left
      have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) [MOD 7] := by
        have : n = 3 * (n / 3) := by
          exact (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
        simpa [this]
      have : (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) ≡ ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) [MOD 7] := by
        simpa [pow_mul] using (Nat.ModEq.rfl :
          (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) [MOD 7])
      have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
        have : (2 ^ 3) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by norm_num
        exact this.pow _
      simpa using this.trans (this.trans this)
    · right; left
      have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + 1)) [MOD 7] := by
        have : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 1 := by
          have := Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (by decide : 0 < 3) n
          sorry
      sorry
    · right; right
      sorry
  rcases hmod with h1 | h2 | h4
  · have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = (1 + 1) % 7 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using congrArg (fun x => (x + 1) % 7) h1
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 2 % 7 := by simpa using this
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    exact (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h).elim this
  · have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = (2 + 1) % 7 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using congrArg (fun x => (x + 1) % 7) h2
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 3 % 7 := by simpa using this
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    exact (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h).elim this
  · have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = (4 + 1) % 7 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using congrArg (fun x => (x + 1) % 7) h4
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 5 % 7 := by simpa using this
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    exact (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h).elim this
```
